long_biography.plain_text:
Passenger transport was already part of Ringeard's family environment when he set out independently in 1968. He bought a small Vendée operator with three coaches and steadily added tourism activities. Eleven years later, acquiring Transvendéens' passenger business gave him a fleet of roughly one hundred vehicles and the foundation for Sovetours.

From the 1980s, expansion increasingly came through acquisitions, creating a network of interurban and school-transport companies across western France. Groupe FAST later brought those operations together with coach distribution, parts supply and tourism. Ringeard moved from executive presidency to chairing its supervisory board, while Arnaud became president and Xavier continued as director general.
